name: g1
goal: Train a 29-DoF Unitree G1 walking policy in mjlab/MuJoCo Warp and transfer to CPU MuJoCo. Stand 2 s, walk forward at 0.6 m/s for 18 s.
score: 100 * walking survival fraction * exp(-mean absolute speed error/0.6). Success additionally requires full survival, speed error<0.25 m/s, forward travel>7.02 m, lateral drift<2 m.
feedback: Video frames and noisy measurements only; no deployment scores, contacts, parameters, seeds or true state. Diagnosis is a short observation/change/prediction, not private reasoning.
policy_abi: numeric fixed MLP NPZ (8 MiB maximum)
limitations: Simulation transfer only, not hardware. Fixed 98→512→256→128→29 ELU actor, frozen public PD wrapper. Coding-agent feedback contains only joint angles and images.
